proposals: The Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare should publish each weekly kharif and rabi sowing-progress report on UPAg as a downloadable state-by-crop table, with the same-date figure for the previous year, so state falls like Uttar Pradesh's 37 per cent in maize can be checked against a primary source rather than secondary news coverage.

The Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare should mark partial-year rows on UPAg, such as the 2025–26 maize row of 4.32 lakh hectares, as provisional in both the dashboard and every data export, so an incomplete season is not mistaken for a 95 per cent collapse in area.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publish a standing table of ex-mill ethanol prices by feedstock and ethanol supply year, with OMC procurement volume and spend by feedstock, so figures like maize's ₹71.86 a litre and 498.49 crore litres are available without waiting for a Parliament reply.

The oil marketing companies should publish, for every ethanol tender cycle, the quantity offered, the quantity allocated and the requirement, split by feedstock, so the gap between 1,776.49 crore litres offered and roughly 1,050 crore litres required in ESY 2025–26 Cycle 1 can be tracked cycle by cycle.

The Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare should give every UPAg crop-profile chart a text or CSV version of the data it plots, so the dashboard's canvas rendering no longer blocks anyone from extracting the official area, production and yield series it displays.
